reviews.reviewbody:
Shri Dashbodh is not just a book of text, its a box of knowledge.
The whole life & how to live it, its explained by Samarth Ramdaas Swami, with proper & very simple examples.
He is the man who dreamt of Hindavi Swarajya juse like Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.
His way to get that was different. He helped a lot Shivaji maharaj without letting Muslim Kings know about them...

Thank you very much for uploading that.
reviews.reviewtitle: Thanks for Sharing such a great book
